review.method: Compared actual graph, metadata, bundle and source-rule inventory with the frozen oracle. Audited six directly relevant local exit observations against the pinned source. Inspected selected caller/consumer observations and generic graph calls as dependency evidence, not as full extra-observation audits.
review.independence_limit: Agent review after the oracle was frozen; this reviewer contributed generic Cartograph implementation work and is not an independent human auditor.

cartograph.commit_provenance: Run revision supplied by root; score is additionally pinned to the actual output file hashes.

output.scope: source-only TypeScript adapter and stored-fact spec projection; no full ingest, flow inference, target execution or acceptance scoring

local_anchor_audit.scope_limit: Only the six directly matched local anchors received this source audit; no precision claim is made for the remaining 133 observations or the complete graph.

full_rule_precision.reason: The relevant output asserts local guarded exits and explicitly disclaims complete predicates and consumer effects. Zero complete claims does not establish 100 percent precision or satisfy the precision acceptance gate.

decision_cases.reason: Reading source and comparing stored observations is not execution of the frozen decision-case matrix.

negative_claim_review.scope_limit: The inventory explicitly limits interpretation. This is not an exhaustive negative-claim audit of every generated observation, nor an executed case result.

score.reason: No complete rule matches, decision cases unexecuted, and extraction input does not contain the full frozen source dependency closure.
